decisions.reason: As a core cutting and creasing finisher that fits the firm's standard postpress portfolio and automation story, it is likely to remain in a growing market.

Despite being farther from the traditional core, the UV spot varnishing system was launched as a Germany premiere and strategic focus, so management would normally continue backing it unless demand clearly disappointed.
The B2-format multifinisher is close to the firm's main business and was highlighted prominently, making it one of the least likely products to be withdrawn.
A hybrid saddle stitcher strengthens the firm's booklet-making and binding offer, so it remains a sensible part of a broad finishing portfolio.
The folding add-on is less prominently marketed than the flagship systems, but its modular fit and evidence of a customer installation argue for keeping it on the market.
